title: The Internet Runs Along the Ocean Floor 🌊 #shorts
description:
Your videos from across the world don't come from satellites. About 99% of the data crossing the oceans runs through undersea cables, often only about an inch thick in deep water. Inside, glass fibers carry flashes of laser light, repeaters powered at up to 15,000 volts boost the signal, and the biggest threat isn't sharks: it's fishing boats and anchors.

Follow Hidden Mechanics for more everyday engineering, explained in under a minute.
